items.title: AI-Powered Briefing Platform
items.summary: A platform built to replace the manual, inconsistent steps of the agency's briefing process — 11 guided stages, AI-assisted content, and structured output ready for design.
items.challenge: Every web design project started the same way: a designer manually gathering information from the client, extracting visual identity from screenshots, and rewriting the same spec structure from scratch. Time-consuming, inconsistent, and entirely dependent on whoever was putting that brief together.
items.solution: An 11-step guided briefing system with 243 visual templates and 26 component categories (~16,000 lines of code). The client fills in the information; the system automatically analyzes their existing website using Puppeteer, extracts the visual identity, and uses Google Gemini to assist with content interpretation. On completion, it generates a structured PDF, a Bitrix24-synced dataset, a Figma component map, and a navigable preview of the new site. Architecture principle: determinism where it matters, AI where it adds value.
items.result: The system centralizes and automates steps that previously depended on manual collection and organization of information. Designers start each project with a complete, structured brief — and a Figma component map already prepared.

items.title: Front-end BI & Management Dashboard
items.summary: An operational dashboard built to give real visibility into the front-end team's work — deliveries, quality, and individual progress, all in one place.
items.challenge: Managing a front-end development team without real data on delivery progress, individual quality, or process bottlenecks. Decisions depended on subjective assessments and manually compiled reports from different sources.
items.solution: A management dashboard pulling live data from Bitrix24's REST API — tasks, cards, and logged time — and from the RHiD API for attendance and timekeeping. A MySQL database handles internal configuration: team registration, weights, permissions, and other settings. Reports are built dynamically from the data retrieved via these integrations. All charts built from scratch with SVG and CSS — no charting library. I designed the system, built the front-end, the integration layer, and the database queries, and handle the deployment.
items.result: The team's work is now visible, trackable, and structured. Every metric the dashboard shows was previously compiled manually, from different sources, without a consistent format.

items.title: Clínica Balvedi
items.summary: A healthcare website built to be extended — the current version is the foundation for a planned roadmap of SEO, lead generation, and AI-powered features.
items.challenge: A medical clinic needed a web presence that felt modern and trustworthy — and that was built in a way that could support future features without requiring a full rebuild.
items.solution: A React website with Framer Motion animations, responsive design, and a modular component architecture. CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions for consistent, automated deployments.
items.result: Advanced SEO, visibility for AI-powered search, lead generation mechanics, a patient engagement chatbot, interactive simulators, and analytics. The architecture was designed with these phases in mind — none of this requires starting over.

about.label: About
about.title: The person behind the work
paragraphs: Over 4 years working professionally in web development, I've built and delivered 400+ websites and landing pages for real clients. My experience sits at the intersection of design and front-end development: I can think visually about an interface and build it — no gap between concept and implementation.

Beyond websites and landing pages, I've been working on more complex web applications — using React, Next.js, Vue 3, Nuxt, TypeScript, and integrations with APIs, databases, and AI tools. Projects I built from scratch and that are currently in use.

I currently also lead the Front-end Development team at my company. That responsibility taught me to think beyond technical delivery — about process quality, team consistency, and real outcomes. I'm still a developer. But I also pay attention to what we're building and why.
